SPOON_MONSTER_HP.title: Monster HP
SPOON_MONSTER_HP.description: Enemies have {Percent}% of their normal HP.
SPOON_MONSTER_DAMAGE.title: Monster Damage
SPOON_MONSTER_DAMAGE.description: Enemies deal {Percent}% of their normal damage.
SPOON_CARD_SET_STS1_ONLY.title: Slay the Spire 1 Cards
SPOON_CARD_SET_STS1_ONLY.description: Slay the Spire 1 cards for the Ironclad, the Silent, the Defect and the Watcher, and colorless cards for everyone.
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR_MODIFIER.title: Spire Souvenir
SPOON_SPIRE_SOUVENIR_MODIFIER.descriptio: Everyone starts with the Spire Souvenir. Cards from both games; pick your version.
SPOON_NEOW_BLESSING.title: Neow's Blessings
SPOON_NEOW_BLESSING.description: Neow blesses you as usual, after the other modifiers’ choices.
SPOON_MERCHANT_LOANS.title: Merchant Loans
SPOON_MERCHANT_LOANS.description: In co-op, borrow gold from your allies at the merchant. Debts outlive you.
SPOON_ACT4.title: Act 4
SPOON_ACT4.description: Three keys open the way to the Heart.
SPOON_CAMPFIRE_GIFT.title: Campfire Sales
SPOON_CAMPFIRE_GIFT.description: In co-op, sell a card to an ally at the campfire. Name your price.
SPOON_STARTING_CHEST.title: Starting Chest
SPOON_STARTING_CHEST.description: Neow opens a chest: pick 1 of 10 relics.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.title: StS1 Boss Relics
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.description: In acts 2 and 3, the Ancient can offer Slay the Spire 1 boss relics.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.option_description: Choose [gold]1[/gold] of [blue]3[/blue] boss relics instead of this gift.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.option_description_coo: Choose [gold]1[/gold] of [blue]3[/blue] boss relics instead of this gift. The chest is shared with the other players who open it.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.waiting: Waiting for the other players to choose.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.won: You win at rock-paper-scissors and take [gold]{Relic}[/gold].
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.consolation: You lose at rock-paper-scissors. Consolation prize: [gold]{Relic}[/gold].
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.lost: You lose at rock-paper-scissors, and the chest is empty.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.skipped: You close the chest without a relic.
SPOON_BOSS_RELICS.none: You already own every available boss relic.
SPOON_MATRIOCHKA.title: Matriochka
SPOON_MATRIOCHKA.description: Hoard everything. Every floor brings cards. Rerolls per act: {Percent}.
SPOON_FOLIE_A_DEUX.title: Folie à deux
SPOON_FOLIE_A_DEUX.description: Every card is up for grabs. Even yours.
SPOON_ROI_MIDAS.title: King Midas
SPOON_ROI_MIDAS.description: Start rich. Gold melts every floor; run dry and you die; in co-op you come back with 1 gold and 1 HP. No free cards; every fire costs gold; each purchase raises prices. Sell relics to the merchant.
SPOON_SPOON.title: Slay the Spoon
SPOON_SPOON.description: Dinner is served. The Spoon is waiting.
SPOON_TEST_RUN.title: Spoon Test
SPOON_TEST_RUN.description: A test start on the Spoon act. It counts toward no progress.
SPOON_FORGE.title: The Forge
SPOON_FORGE.description: Fuse copies at the fire, up to +9. The merchant duplicates cards.
SPOON_MUTATION.title: Mutation
SPOON_MUTATION.description: Each new act transforms every card that is not upgraded.
SPOON_DECK_OF_TEN.title: Deck of 10
SPOON_DECK_OF_TEN.description: Your deck holds 10 cards. Each card dropped gives 1 max HP.
SPOON_CURSED_DECK.title: Cursed Deck
SPOON_CURSED_DECK.description: Start with the Unholy Grimoire: curses are playable. Events and relics lean cursed.
SPOON_CURSED_DECK.neow_description: Choose [gold]1[/gold] of [blue]3[/blue] boss relics. The price: the [purple]Witching Hour[/purple] replaces your [red]Ascender's Bane[/red] (or joins your [gold]Deck[/gold]). Skip to refuse.
SPOON_BLOOD.title: Blood
SPOON_BLOOD.description: No gold: you pay in HP. Start with Blood Fang.
SPOON_TROPHIES.title: Trophies
SPOON_TROPHIES.description: Each elite you beat gives a card: one of its attacks.
SPOON_FORCED_TRADE.title: Forced Trade
SPOON_FORCED_TRADE.description: Co-op: after each victory, everyone gives a card to a random ally.
SPOON_CONDUCTOR.hint: Click a card to give that very card.
SPOON_CONDUCTOR.title: Conductor
SPOON_CONDUCTOR.description: Co-op: after each victory, one player decides who gets each reward.
SPOON_USELESS_RELICS.title: Useless Relics
SPOON_USELESS_RELICS.description: In combat, click a relic that has done its job to throw it at an enemy for 10 damage. It comes back after the fight.
SPOON_ACHILLES_HEEL_MODE.title: Achilles' Heel
SPOON_ACHILLES_HEEL_MODE.description: Everyone starts with Achilles' Heel and three Block relics.
SPOON_GLASS_CANNON.title: Glass Cannon
SPOON_GLASS_CANNON.description: Everyone starts with Glass Heart, Vajra and Girya.
SPOON_OVERCURSED.title: Overcursed
SPOON_OVERCURSED.description: Every curse you receive comes in three. Events offer to embrace the curse. Ascender's Bane becomes the Witching Hour. Cursed relics turn up more often, merchants and events included.
SPOON_USELESS_RELICS.thrown.title: Thrown
SPOON_USELESS_RELICS.thrown.description: This relic was thrown at an enemy. It does nothing until the fight ends, then comes back.
SPOON_USELESS_RELICS.throwable.title: Throwable
SPOON_USELESS_RELICS.throwable.descripti: This relic has done its job this fight. Click it to throw it at an enemy for [blue]10[/blue] damage.
